verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents querying data directly in S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage, with stored S3 credentials. It also offers DuckLake lakehouses over your own object storage, so the core 'query in place' capability exists. However, the evidence never names Iceberg, Delta, or Parquet support specifically. Missing for 10: explicit Iceberg table support, explicit Delta Lake support, explicit Parquet file querying documentation, hands-on corroboration of in-place querying.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can query open table formats and files in object storage — Iceberg, Delta, Parquet — without first loading them into proprietary storage

citations.quote: Cloud Storage Integration: Query data directly from S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage, and more
You can safely store your Amazon S3 credentials in MotherDuck for convenience by creating a `SECRET` object
Use DuckLake to build a data lake on top of your own files
Spin up a fully managed lakehouse with MotherDuck handling both metadata and storage, or bring your own cloud object storage.
